answer: Farming becomes a marble bet on surviving 48 epochs of grading, and every mesa settlement recomputes the velvet schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 6 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 48 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 30 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
